name: Summoned
source:
One sleepover gone wrong – you summoned the sins. Now try to survive them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

一场出了岔子的过夜派对——你失手召唤出了“七宗罪”。现在，设法在他们手下活下来吧。
